en: Vintage illustrated postcard featuring a large pansy flower. In each petal there is a small inset black‑and‑white photograph of different views of the city, and at the top center is a portrait of a smiling woman with an elaborate hairstyle. The background is plain, and at the bottom right is French text reading "Souvenir de Salonique." Additional small captions in French label the views, such as a white tower, quays and boulevards.
